title: Positive second moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. If there is some $x\in\Omega$ with $p(x)\ne 0$ and $X(x)\ne 0$, then $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)X(x)^2>0$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
